result: every claim tagged with a source was found in that source, and every line marked inference is a fair reading of the source it names or the document's own reasoning
notes: The completion rule (PSEL, PENABLE and PREADY high together) is the stall condition in fapb_slave.v and the response condition in axil2apb.v; the bridge's at-most-half rate is the 50 percent throughput in the axil2apb.v header.
PREADY low during reset: fapb_slave.v asserts PREADY low on the cycle after one with PRESETn low; apbslave.v resets PREADY low and raises it only after a setup cycle.
The bounded wait is the F_OPT_MAXSTALL stall counter in fapb_slave.v; the UMich lecture (its Things left out slide) says it cannot find a limit on how long a device may stall.
The demonstration completer writes memory and loads PRDATA on PSEL with PENABLE low, the setup edge, as the document says.
